text:
Maria Chen: Hey folks — kicking off Oak & Co private VPC onboarding. Noting two immediate blockers: (1) customer-managed KMS key policy isn't attached to the redwood-inference IAM principal, (2) audit-log egress to their SIEM is blocked by firewall. Can we triage?

Jamie Patel: Thanks Maria. We can add the KMS policy, but need the policy example + the key ARN. Also flagging renewal risk if go-live slips past next billing cycle — legal is watching timelines.

Devon Park: I'll take the firewall rule. Can whoever owns the SIEM IPs drop them here? Also need the subnet ID for the NAT gateway used for logging egress.

Anil Rao: KMS key policy sample below — we need the principal ARN that Redwood should be granted. Jamie, can you confirm the account id/role that will be used?

Anil Rao: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-customer-role" },
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Encrypt"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

Jamie Patel: Account id is 123456789012, thanks. We'll validate and attach. On audit retention: legal wants 7 years — is that supported on Private?

Maria Chen: Redwood supports longer retention via S3 archival/Cold storage on Private but we need to confirm the pipeline config & permissions. @Anil can you confirm the retention/archival flow and any IAM perms we need? Also proposing a temporary mitigation: enable hosted log proxy to forward copies to OakCo's SIEM while firewall rule is being updated.

infra-bot: meeting created by Maria — "OakCo VPC onboarding triage" scheduled 2026-04-05 15:00 UTC.

Devon Park: I'll update the ingress/egress playbook and share a terraform snippet for the logging egress rule. Posting quick snippet now.

Devon Park: ```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "oakco_logging_egress" {
  type        = "egress"
  from_port   = 443
  to_port     = 443
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["54.210.34.12/32"] # SIEM collector placeholder
}
```

Jamie Patel: Ack — will try to get our SIEM collector IPs by EOD and confirm subnet ID. Runbook link is helpful: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/private-onboard

Maria Chen: Action items summary: (1) Jamie — share SIEM IP + attach KMS policy with the ARN (due EOD), (2) Devon — submit firewall TF change + temp proxy plan (due tomorrow), (3) Anil — confirm retention approach & required IAM perms (due tomorrow). If we miss EOD for the KMS attach, mark as renewal-risk and escalate to AM. :warning:

Anil Rao: Confirmed — retention via archival + lifecycle rules is supported on Private. I'll post the minimal IAM policy and a recommended rotation cadence. Also recommend rotating the key at cutover to minimize exposure.

Jamie Patel: Thanks team — I'll update after I speak with our infra lead.

Maria Chen: Great. I'll add these action items to the onboarding tracker and follow up after the triage meeting. :thumbsup:
